outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
cohort: Singleton pregnant women with placenta previa and suspected PAS from gestational age 28 weeks until delivery who had ultrasounds at a PAS tertiary referral center.
finding: Prenatal diagnosis of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) using Transabdominal Ultrasound (TAS) with adjunct Transvaginal Ultrasound (TVS) improved PAS diagnostic accuracy, especially in lower-experienced operators.
cross-section timing: Scans were performed from gestational age 28 weeks until delivery.
gest_age: From gestational age 28 weeks until delivery
